demo.title: earn-session.txt
demo.code:
You: Compare EARN vaults and Omnipools for my USDG.
Bankr: Reads live fee APR, reward APR, TVL and deposit routes.
You: Put 25 USDG into the CASHCAT Auto vault.
Bankr: Checks the vault, wallet balance and route; presents amounts, protected shares, approvals, gas and risks for confirmation.
You: Confirm.
Bankr: Submits the reviewed approvals, refreshes and simulates the deposit, then reports the confirmed receipt and resulting vault shares. Stops if any check fails.

setup: Install this skill using the command below.
Use an authenticated Bankr wallet with Robinhood Chain (4663) support. Public EARN discovery does not require an EARN API key.
For transactions, fund that wallet on Robinhood Chain with the deposit assets and enough ETH for gas. Existing Bankr signing permissions and security controls apply.
Ask to compare EARN Auto vaults or Omnipools. Review and explicitly confirm each proposed deposit, withdrawal or reward claim.
